title: Ontario LTB Form N4 - Notice to End your Tenancy Early for Non-payment of Rent (filled, weekly rent)
source: synthetic (written for this project; organisations and people are fictional)
notes: Official N4 wording (Tribunals Ontario, v. 01/04/2022) with fictional fill-in values for a weekly tenancy.
summary_en: A landlord's official N4 notice for a room rented by the week: the tenant owes $560.00 and must pay by the termination date, 14/09/2026, or the landlord may apply to evict.
text:
Notice to End your Tenancy
For Non-payment of Rent
N4
To: (Tenant's name) include all tenant names: Tesfay Ghebre
From: (Landlord's name): Ada Okafor
Address of the Rental Unit: Room 2, 77 Coxwell Avenue, Toronto, Ontario M4L 3A8
This is a legal notice that could lead to you being evicted from your home.
The following information is from your landlord
I am giving you this notice because I believe you owe me $560.00 in rent.
I can apply to the Board to have you evicted if you do not:
• pay this amount by 14/09/2026. This is called the termination date.
Or
• move out by the termination date.
WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW
The following information is provided by the Landlord and Tenant Board
The termination date: The date that the landlord gives you in this notice to pay or move out must be at least: 14 days after the landlord gives you the notice, if you rent by the month or year, or 7 days after the landlord gives you the notice, if you rent by the day or week.
What if you agree with the notice? If you agree that you owe the amount that the landlord is claiming, you should pay this amount by the termination date in this notice. If you do so, the landlord cannot apply to the Board to evict you based on this notice.
What if you disagree with the notice? You do not have to move out if you disagree with this notice. You may also want to get legal advice.

Rent Period From: 31/08/2026 To: 06/09/2026 Rent Charged $280.00 Rent Paid $0.00 Rent Owing $280.00
